    explored = set()
    while frontier:
        path = frontier.pop(0)
        if path[-1] == goal:
            return path
        last_node = path[-1]
        if last_node not in explored:
            for neighbor in graph.get(last_node, []):
                new_path = list(path)
                new_path.append(neighbor)
                frontier.append(new_path)
            explored.add(last_node)
    return None
